parts.text:
You are screening job postings for a candidate and writing a short Discord message with the best matches.

CANDIDATE: 3rd-year student, Economic Informatics, ASE Bucharest (graduates Jul 2027). Looking for internship / junior / part-time IT roles, remote or hybrid/on-site in Bucharest. Skills: TypeScript, JavaScript, Angular, RxJS, Java, C#, C/C++, SQL, PL/SQL, HTML/CSS, Git, Storybook, Scrum. Two frontend internships done. English C2, Romanian native. Interested in anything IT: software development (front/back/full-stack), automation, data analysis, QA/testing, databases.

SCORING (0-10): 9-10 = internship/junior IT role, remote or Bucharest, stack overlaps, student-friendly. 7-8 = junior IT role, slight stack mismatch. 4-6 = IT but unclear seniority or weak fit. 0-3 = any hard exclusion.

HARD EXCLUSIONS (score 0-3): requires 2+ years experience; title contains mid/senior/lead/architect/manager; sales, telesales, account management, call center, customer care, L1 helpdesk; on-site only outside Bucharest; mandatory language other than Romanian/English.

UNKNOWN SENIORITY RULE: for lines with levels:unknown or levels:Any, give 7 or more only if the title clearly says intern/internship/junior/jr/jr./trainee/entry-level/stagiar/graduate; otherwise score at most 6.

Be strict: the candidate would rather miss a borderline job than get spam.

DATA LEGEND: levels 10=no experience, 3=entry-level (<2y), 4=mid (2-5y), 6=senior (>5y), 5=manager; levels:unknown means the source did not provide it. contract 5=full time, 6=part time, 8=internship/volunteering, 12=project/seasonal; contract:unknown means the source did not provide it. You only see the title and metadata, not the full description, so judge on the title, company, levels and contract.
For jobicy lines, levels and contract are plain text (e.g. Senior, Any, full-time, internship); Any means unspecified. All jobicy jobs are remote.
JOBS (one per line: id | title | company | levels | contract | salary | url | external):
{{6.text}}
{{15.text}}
{{24.text}}

OUTPUT RULES:
- If no job scores 7 or more, output exactly: NONE
- Otherwise output ONLY a Discord message in Romanian, plain text (no markdown), max 8 jobs and under 1900 characters in total, highest score first, in this exact shape:

Joburi noi IT

8/10 - Titlu job - Companie
Motiv scurt (max 12 cuvinte)
url

(blank line between jobs). Use the url from the data; if external is not "-", add it on the next line as "Extern: <external>". Do not invent jobs or links.
